Lemma
[Majorants] ↗ def:power-series-majorizes ↗ ex:real-analytic-example-rational-function 1. ch4:4.6.2-lem-1\group Power Series Methods

If $g\gg f$ and $g$ converges for $|x|<r$, then $f$ converges there. If $f$ converges for $|x|<r$ and $0<s\sqrt n<r$, then $f$ has a majorant on $|x|<s\sqrt n$.

Proof

\sketch The coefficient inequality gives absolute convergence of $f$ wherever $g$ converges. For the converse, evaluate the convergent series at $y=s(1,\ldots ,1)$ to bound $|f_\alpha |$, then majorize by $Cs/[s-(x_1+\cdots +x_n)]$.

□
